title: FREEMAIN DATAPOINTER(ptr): releases the block GETMAIN returned and leaves a second block usable (NORMAL); the address of a WORKING-STORAGE item is INVREQ RESP2 1

scenarios.summary: HCFMRL GETMAINs two 8-byte blocks, writes through the first view, FREEMAIN DATAPOINTER of the first, then writes the second and FREEMAIN DATAPOINTER of it: NORMAL each time
HCFMIV FREEMAIN DATAPOINTER of the address of one of its own WORKING-STORAGE items: INVREQ RESP2 1, the item unchanged, a later GETMAIN and FREEMAIN NORMAL
